csv_project_name: DB for CCSFS New Public Water Supply Well
csv_agency: US Army Corps of Engineers New England District
csv_scope_of_work: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, New England District is issuing this Sources Sought Notice (SSN) for Construction Services to execute a Design-Build contract for the Construction of a New Public Water Supply Well project located at CCSFS, Bourne, MA. The objective of this project is to enhance water security and resiliency at CCSFS by constructing a new water supply well to serve as the primary source for all occupants. There are currently two (2) water supply wells at the installation drilled in overburden near the base of a glacial deposit. The scope includes all work required to turn over a fully functional and Massachusetts Department of Environmental Protection (MassDEP) compliant water supply well to the Government.
